s.d: κατα-τοξεύω [in LXX: [[exodus 19 13|Exo.19:13]] (יָרָה), al. ;] to strike down with an arrow, shoot dead: [[hebrews 12 20|Heb.12:20]] (LXX) (Rec.; WH, R, om.).† (AS)
κατα-τρέχω [in LXX: [[leviticus 26 37|Lev.26:37]], [[judges 1 6|Jdg.1:6]] (רָדַף), al. ;] to run down: before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), [[acts 21 32|Act.21:32.]]† (AS)

κατα-φέρω [in LXX for יָרַד hi., etc. ;] to bring down: αἰτιώματα, [[acts 25 7|Act.25:7;]] ψῆφον, to cast a ballot, [[acts 26 10|Act.26:10;]] pass., to be borne down: ὕπνῳ, ἀπὸ τ. ὕ., [[acts 20 9|Act.20:9.]]† (AS)
κατα-φεύγω [in LXX for נוּס, etc. ;] to flee for refuge: before εἰς, [[acts 14 6|Act.14:6;]] metaphorically, with inf., [[hebrews 6 18|Heb.6:18.]]† (AS)

κατα-φθείρω [in LXX chiefly for שָׁחַת hi., [[genesis 6 12|Gen.6:12]], al. ;] 1 1 to destroy entirely. 2. In moral sense (as LXX), to deprave, corrupt: pass. pf. ptcp., before τ. νο ν, [[2-timothy 3 8|2Ti.3:8.]]† (AS)

κατα-φιλέω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for נָשַׁק ;] to kiss fervently, kiss affectionately: [[matthew 26 49|Mat.26:49]], [[mark 14 45|Mrk.14:45]], [[luke 7 38|Luk.7:38, 45 15:20]], [[acts 20 37|Act.20:37]].† (AS)

κατα-φρονέω, -ῶ [in LXX for בָּגַד, בּוּז, etc. ;] to think little of, despise: with genitive, [[matthew 6 24|Mat.6:24 18:10]], [[luke 16 13|Luk.16:13]], [[romans 2 4|Rom.2:4]], [[1-corinthians 11 22|1Co.11:22]], [[1-timothy 4 12|1Ti.4:12 6:2]], [[hebrews 12 2|Heb.12:2]], [[2-peter 2 10|2Pe.2:10]].† (AS)
κατα-φρονητής, -οῦ, ὁ [in LXX for בָּגַד, בֹּגְדוֹת, [[habakkuk 1 5|Hab.1:5 2:5]], [[zephaniah 3 4|Zep.3:4]] * ;] a despiser: [[acts 13 41|Act.13:41.]]† (AS)
κατα-χέω [in LXX for יָצַק, נָטָה, עָטָה hi. ;] to pour down upon: with genitive (cl.), [[mark 14 3|Mrk.14:3;]] before ἐπί, with genitive, [[matthew 26 7|Mat.26:7.]]† (AS)
κατα-χθόνιος, -ον (χθών, the earth), subterranean, under the earth (in cl., of the infernal gods): of the departed in Hades, opposite to ἐπουράνιος, ἐπίγειος, [[philippians 2 10|Php.2:10.]]† (AS)

κατα-χράομαι, -ῶμαι [in LXX: Ep. Je.28, 3Ma.4:5 3Mac 5:22 * ;] to make full use of, use to the uttermost, use up: [[1-corinthians 7 31|1Co.7:31;]] with dative, [[1-corinthians 9 18|1Co.9:18]] (for other senses, see LS, see word)..† (AS)
κατα-ψύχω [in LXX: [[genesis 18 4|Gen.18:4]] (שָׁעַן ni.)* ;] to cool: with accusative, [[luke 16 24|Luk.16:24.]]† (AS)
κατείδωλος, -ον (εἴδωλον), full of idols: [[acts 17 16|Act.17:16.]]† (AS)

κατέναντι adv., [in LXX chiefly for נֶגֶד, פָּנִים, [[genesis 7 1|Gen.7:1]], etc. ;] over against, opposite, before: ἡ, κ. κώμη, [[luke 19 30|Luk.19:30;]] as prep., with genitive, [[matthew 21 2|Mat.21:2 27:24]] (ἀπ-, WH, mg.), [[mark 11 2|Mrk.11:2 12:41]] (ἀπ-, WH, mg.) [[mark 13 3|Mrk.13:3;]] metaphorically, before, before θεοῦ, [[romans 4 17|Rom.4:17]], [[2-corinthians 2 17|2Co.2:17 12:19]].† (AS)

κατενώπιον adv. (= Hom., κατένωπα), [in LXX: [[psalms 44 15|Psa.44:15]], al. ;] over against, before: with genitive, τ. δόξης, Ju 24; metaphorically (cf. κατέναντι, and see Lft., Col., l.with), τ. θεοῦ, [[ephesians 1 4|Eph.1:4]], [[colossians 1 22|Col.1:22]].† (AS)
κατ-εξουσιάζω to exercise authority over: with genitive of person(s), [[matthew 20 25|Mat.20:25]], [[mark 10 42|Mrk.10:42]].† SYN: (κατακυριεύω) (see Swete, Mk., l.with) (AS)

κατ-εργάζομαι (emphatic form of ἐργάζομαι), [in LXX for פָּעַל, etc. (9 exx., each for a different Heb. word) ;] to effect by labour, achieve, work out, bring about: with accusative, [[romans 4 15|Rom.4:15 5:3 7:8, 15-20]], [[2-corinthians 7 10|2Co.7:10]], [[ephesians 6 13|Eph.6:13]], [[james 1 3|Jas.1:3]]; pass., [[2-corinthians 12 12|2Co.12:12;]] with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), [[romans 7 13|Rom.7:13]], [[2-corinthians 4 17|2Co.4:17 7:11 9:11]]; id. before διά, with genitive of person(s), [[romans 15 18|Rom.15:18;]] τ. σωτηρίαν, [[philippians 2 12|Php.2:12;]] with accusative of person(s) before εἰς, [[2-corinthians 5 5|2Co.5:5]] (RV, wrought); of evil deeds, [[romans 1 27|Rom.1:27 2:9]], [[1-corinthians 5 3|1Co.5:3]], [[1-peter 4 3|1Pe.4:3]].† (AS)

κατ-έρχομαι [in LXX: Tob.1:22, א Tob.2:1, [[esther 3 13|Est.3:13]], Wis.11:22, 2Ma.11:29 * ;] to come down, go down: before εἰς, [[luke 4 31|Luk.4:31]], [[acts 8 5|Act.8:5 13:4 15:30 19:1]], Τ; ἀπό, [[luke 9 37|Luk.9:37]], [[acts 15 1|Act.15:1 18:5 21:10]]; ἀπό and εἰς, [[acts 11 27|Act.11:27 12:10]]; of coming to port by ship, [[acts 18 22|Act.18:22 21:3 27:5]]; before πρός, with accusative of person(s), [[acts 9 32|Act.9:32;]] metaphorically, of gifts from God, [[james 3 15|Jas.3:15.]]† (AS)

κατ-εσθίω ("perfective" comp. of ἐσθίω, which see, and cf. M, Pr., 111) [in LXX chiefly for אָכַל ;] to eat up, devour: with accusative, of seed, [[matthew 13 4|Mat.13:4]], [[mark 4 4|Mrk.4:4]], [[luke 8 5|Luk.8:5]]; τέκνον, [[revelation 12 4|Rev.12:4;]] βιβλαρίδιον, [[revelation 10 9|Rev.10:9-10;]] metaphorically, οἰκίας, [[matthew 23 13|Mat.23:13]], [[mark 12 40|Mrk.12:40]], [[luke 20 47|Luk.20:47]]; τ. βίον, [[luke 15 30|Luk.15:30;]] with accusative of person(s), [[john 2 17|Jhn.2:17]] (LXX), [[2-corinthians 11 20|2Co.11:20]], [[galatians 5 15|Gal.5:15]], [[revelation 11 5|Rev.11:5 20:9]].† (AS)

κατ-ευθύνω [in LXX for כּוּן ni., hi., etc. ;] to make or keep straight, direct, guide: metaphorically, τ. ὁδόν, [[1-thessalonians 3 11|1Th.3:11;]] τ. πόδας εἰς ὁδὸν εἰρήνης, [[luke 1 79|Luk.1:79;]] τ. καρδίας εἰς τ. ἀγάπην, [[2-thessalonians 3 5|2Th.3:5.]]† (AS)
κατ-εφ-ίστημι to rise up against: [[acts 18 12|Act.18:12.]]† (AS)

κατ-έχω [in LXX for אָחַז, חָזַק hi., etc. ;] 1. perfective of ἔχω (M, Pr., 116; M, Th., 155), (a) to possess, hold fast: [[luke 8 15|Luk.8:15]], [[john 5 4|Jhn.5:4]], [[romans 1 18|Rom.1:18]] (Lft., Notes, 251), [[1-corinthians 7 30|1Co.7:30 11:2]], [[2-corinthians 6 10|2Co.6:10]], [[1-thessalonians 5 21|1Th.5:21]], [[hebrews 3 6|Heb.3:6, 14 10:23]]; (b) to lay hold of, get possession of: [[luke 14 9|Luk.14:9.]] 2. to hold back, detain, restrain (M, Th., 156 f.): with accusative before τοῦ μή with inf., [[luke 4 42|Luk.4:42;]] before πρός, with accusative, Phm 13; absol., τὸ κατέχον (ὁ κ.), [[2-thessalonians 2 6|2Th.2:6-7.]] 3. Intrans., as nautical term, to put in, make for (LS, see word): [[acts 27 40|Act.27:40.]]† (AS)

κατηγορέω, -ῶ (κατά, ἀγορεύω), [in LXX: Dan LXX 6:5, (9), 1Ma.7:6 1Mac 7:25, 2Ma.4:47 2Mac 10:13 2Mac 10:21, 4Ma.9:14 * ;] to make accusation, accuse, (a) in general: absol., [[romans 2 15|Rom.2:15;]] with genitive of person(s) (cl., WM, 254), [[john 5 45|Jhn.5:45;]] irreg. with accusative of person(s), [[revelation 12 10|Rev.12:10;]] (b) before a judge: absol., [[acts 24 2|Act.24:2, 19]]; with genitive of person(s), [[matthew 12 10|Mat.12:10]], [[mark 3 2|Mrk.3:2]], [[luke 6 7|Luk.6:7 11:54]] (WH, txt., R, om.), [[luke 23 2|Luk.23:2, 10]], [[john 8 6|Jhn.8:6]] [[acts 25 5|Act.25:5 28:19]]; id. with accusative of thing(s) (cl., but see WM, l.with), [[mark 15 3|Mrk.15:3-4;]] with genitive of thing(s) (Dem.), [[acts 24 8|Act.24:8 25:11]]; before περί, with genitive of thing(s) (Thuc., viii, 85), [[acts 24 13|Act.24:13;]] with accusative of thing(s), before κατά with genitive of person(s) (WM, § 28, 1), [[luke 23 14|Luk.23:14.]] Pass. (B1., § 54, 3), before ὑπό with genitive, [[matthew 27 12|Mat.27:12]], [[acts 22 30|Act.22:30]]; ὁ κατηγορούμενος, [[acts 25 16|Act.25:16.]]† (AS)

κατηγορία, -ας, ἡ (κατήγορος), an accusation, charge: with genitive of person(s), [[john 18 29|Jhn.18:29;]] before κατά, with id., [[1-timothy 5 19|1Ti.5:19;]] with genitive of thing(s), [[titus 1 6|Tit.1:6.]]† (AS)
κατήγορος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX: [[proverbs 18 17|Pro.18:17]] (רִיב), 2Ma.4:5 * ;] an accuser: [[acts 23 30|Act.23:30, 35 24:8]] (WH, R, txt. om.) [[acts 25 16|Act.25:16, 18]].† (AS)
κατήφεια, -ας, ἡ (κατηφής, downcast, Wis.17:4 *), dejection: [[james 4 9|Jas.4:9.]]† (AS)

κατ-ηχέω, -ῶ 1. to resound. 2. to teach by word of mouth, instruct, inform (see 131., Phil. Gosp., 20, 31): [[galatians 6 6|Gal.6:6;]] with accusative of person(s), [[1-corinthians 14 19|1Co.14:19;]] pass. with accusative of thing(s), [[luke 1 4|Luk.1:4]] (ICC, in l), [[acts 18 25|Act.18:25 21:24]] (cf. Lk, l.with), [[galatians 6 6|Gal.6:6;]] before κ, with genitive of thing(s), [[romans 2 18|Rom.2:18;]] περί, with genitive of person(s), [[acts 21 21|Act.21:21.]]† (AS)
κατ-ιόω, -ῶ (intensive of ἰόω; ἰός) [in LXX: Sir.12:11 * ;] to rust over; pass., become rusted over: [[james 5 3|Jas.5:3.]]† (AS)
κατ-ισχύω [in LXX chiefly for חָזַק ;] to overpower, prevail against, prevail: absol., [[luke 23 23|Luk.23:23;]] with inf., [[luke 21 36|Luk.21:36;]] with genitive, [[matthew 16 18|Mat.16:18.]]† (AS)

κατ-οικέω, -ῶ [in LXX very frequently and nearly always for יָשַׁב ;] 1. trans., to inhabit, dwell in: with accusative, [[luke 13 4|Luk.13:4]], [[acts 1 10|Act.1:10 2:9, 14 4:16 9:32, 35 19:10]], 17. [[revelation 17 2|Rev.17:2]]; of God, [[matthew 23 21|Mat.23:21.]] 2. Intrans., to settle, dwell: [[acts 22 12|Act.22:12;]] before ἐν (cl.), [[acts 1 20|Act.1:20]] (LXX) [[acts 2 5|Act.2:5 7:2, 4 7:48 9:22 11:29 13:27 17:24]], [[hebrews 11 9|Heb.11:9]], [[revelation 13 12|Rev.13:12]]; before εἰς (B1., § 39, 3; M, Pr., 62 f., 234 f.), [[matthew 2 23|Mat.2:23 4:13]], [[acts 7 4|Act.7:4]]; ἐπὶ τ. γῆς ([[numbers 13 33|Num.13:33]], al.), [[revelation 3 10|Rev.3:10 6:10 8:13 11:10 13:8, 14 17:8]]; ἐπὶ παντὸς προσώπου τ. γ., [[acts 17 26|Act.17:26;]] ὅπου, [[revelation 2 13|Rev.2:13;]] ἐκεῖ (of demons), [[matthew 12 45|Mat.12:45]], [[luke 11 26|Luk.11:26]]. Metaphorical, of divine indwelling: ὁ Χριστός, [[ephesians 3 17|Eph.3:17;]] τ. πνεῦμα, [[james 4 5|Jas.4:5]] (κατῴκισεν, T, WH, R, txt.); τ. πλήωρμα (τ. θεότητος), [[colossians 1 19|Col.1:19 2:9]]; δικαιοσύνη (cf. Wis.1:4), [[2-peter 3 13|2Pe.3:13]] (cf. ἐν-κατοικέω).† κατοικίζω, [in LXX for יָשַׁב hi., etc. ;] to cause to dwell: metaphorically, with accusative, τὸ πνεῦμα, [[james 4 5|Jas.4:5]] (Rec., R, mg., κατῴκησεν).† (AS)
κατ-οίκησις, -εως, ἡ (κατοικέω), [in LXX for יָשַׁב, [[genesis 10 30|Gen.10:30]], al. ;] dwelling: [[mark 5 3|Mrk.5:3.]]† (AS)
κατ-οικητήριον, -ου, τό (κατοικέω), [in LXX for מוֹשָׁב, מָעוֹן, etc. ;] a habitation, dwelling-place: [[ephesians 2 22|Eph.2:22]], [[revelation 18 2|Rev.18:2]].† (AS)
κατ-οικία, -ας, ἡ (κατοικέω), [in LXX chiefly for מוֹשָׁב, [[exodus 35 3|Exo.35:3]], al. ;] 1. a dwelling: [[acts 17 26|Act.17:26.]] 2. a settlement (Polyb.).† (AS)

κατοπτρίζω (κάτοπτρον, a mirror), to show as in a mirror. Mid., to see oneself mirrored (see MM, Exp., xv); with accusative of thing(s) (R, txt., but see mg.), to reflect as a mirror: [[2-corinthians 3 18|2Co.3:18]] (cf. Abbott, Essays, 94).† (AS)
κατόρθωμα, -τος, τό Rec, for διόρθωμα (which see), [[acts 24 3|Act.24:3.]]† (AS)

κάτω adv. (κατά), [in LXX for מַטָּה, תַּחַת and cogn. forms ;] 1. down, downwards (with verbs of motion), [[matthew 4 6|Mat.4:6]], [[luke 4 9|Luk.4:9]], [[john 8 6|Jhn.8:6]], 8, [[acts 20 9|Act.20:9]]. 2. below, beneath: [[mark 14 66|Mrk.14:66]], [[acts 2 19|Act.2:19]]" (LXX) ; ἕως κ. ([[ezekiel 1 27|Eze.1:27]], al.), [[matthew 27 51|Mat.27:51]], [[mark 15 38|Mrk.15:38]]. τὰ κ. (opposite to τ. ἄνω), [[john 8 23|Jhn.8:23.]] Compar. κατωτέρω: ἀπὸ διετοῦς καὶ κ. (cf. [[1-chronicles 27 21|1Ch.27:21]]), [[matthew 2 16|Mat.2:16]].† (AS)

κατώτερος, -έρα, -ερον (κάτω), [in LXX for תַּחְתּוֹן, תַּחְתִּי ;] lower; τὰ. κ. τῆς γῆς (see AR, Eph., l.with; for rendering this lower earth, see ICC, Eph, l.with), the lower parts of the earth (cf. [[psalms 139 15|Psa.139:15;]] cf. also MGr., ἡ κάτου γῆ, the underworld, Thumb, MGV, 334): [[ephesians 4 9|Eph.4:9.]]† (AS)
καῦμα, -τος, τό (καίω), [in LXX for חֹם, חֹרֶב, etc. ;] heat: [[revelation 7 16|Rev.7:16 16:9]].† (AS)

καυματίζω (καῦμα), to burn or scorch up: with accusative before ἐν πυρί, [[revelation 16 8|Rev.16:8.]] Pass., [[matthew 13 14|Mat.13:14]], [[mark 4 6|Mrk.4:6]]; before καῦμα μέγα, [[revelation 16 9|Rev.16:9.]]† (AS)
καῦσις, -εως, ἡ (καίω), [in LXX for בָּעַר pi., etc. ;] burning: [[hebrews 6 8|Heb.6:8.]]† (AS)
καυσόω, -ῶ (καῦσος, burning heat, fever), only in pass., 1. to burn with fever (Galen., al.). 2. In NT, to burn with great heat: [[2-peter 3 10|2Pe.3:10 3:12]] (V. Mayor, in l).† (AS)

καύσων, -ωνος, ὁ (καίω), [in LXX: [[genesis 31 40|Gen.31:40]] א (חֹרֶב), [[isaiah 49 10|Isa.49:10]] (שָׁרָב), [[job 27 21|Job.27:21]], [[hosea 12 1|Hos.12:1]], (2), [[hosea 13 15|Hos.13:15]], [[jonah 4 8|Jon.4.8]], [[jeremiah 18 17|Jer.18:17]], [[ezekiel 17 10|Eze.17:10 19:12]] (קָדִים); [[jeremiah 51 1|Jer.51:1]], From Theodotion [[daniel 3 67|Dan.3:67]]) Jdth.8:3, Sir.18:16 34:16 43:22 * ;] 1. burning heat (Ge, Isa (?), Jth, ll.with, Sir.18:16): [[matthew 20 12|Mat.20:12]], [[luke 12 55|Luk.12:55]] ([[james 1 11|Jas.1:11]], AV). 2. a hot wind from the east (Heb. קָדִים, see LXX, ll.with), the modern sirocco (see CGT on [[amos 4 9|Amo.4:9]]): [[james 1 11|Jas.1:11]] (RV, the scorching wind; cf. R, mg., the hot wind, Mt, Lk, ll.with).† (AS)

καυστηριάζω (Rec. καυτηρ-, and so usually in Gk. writers, see Soph., Lex., see word) to mark by branding, brand (AV, scar, but see CGT, in l): metaphorically, pass. pf. ptcp., [[1-timothy 4 2|1Ti.4:2]] (cf. καυτήριον, 4Ma.15:22 *).† (AS)

καυχάομαι, -ῶμαι [in LXX for הָלַל hith., etc. ;] to boast or glory (in LXX, of joyous exultation, and so in the NT quotations, infr.; cf. DB, ii, 790b; Hort on [[james 1 9|Jas.1:9]]): absol., [[1-corinthians 1 31|1Co.1:31]] (LXX) [[1-corinthians 4 7|1Co.4:7 13:3]], [[2-corinthians 10 13|2Co.10:13 10:17]]" (LXX) [[2-corinthians 11 16|2Co.11:16 11:18 12:1 12:6]], [[ephesians 2 9|Eph.2:9]], [[james 4 16|Jas.4:16]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[2-corinthians 9 2|2Co.9:2 11:30]]; before ἐν (LXX), [[romans 2 23|Rom.2:23 5:3]], [[1-corinthians 3 21|1Co.3:21]], [[2-corinthians 5 12|2Co.5:12 10:15 11:12 12:5 12:9]], [[galatians 6 13|Gal.6:13-14]] [[james 1 9|Jas.1:9]]; ἐν (τ.) θεῷ, [[romans 2 17|Rom.2:17 5:11]]; ἐν κυρίῳ, [[1-corinthians 1 31|1Co.1:31]] (LXX) [[2-corinthians 10 17|2Co.10:17]] (LXX); ἐν Χ. Ἰησοῦ, [[philippians 3 3|Php.3:3;]] before ἐπί with dative, [[romans 5 2|Rom.5:2;]] περί, with genitive, [[2-corinthians 10 8|2Co.10:8;]] εἰς, [[2-corinthians 10 16|2Co.10:16;]] ὑπέρ, with genitive of person(s), [[2-corinthians 7 14|2Co.7:14 12:5]]; ἐνώπιον τ. θεοῦ, [[1-corinthians 1 29|1Co.1:29]] (cf. ἐν, κατα-καυχάομαι).† (AS)

καύχημα, -τος, τό (καυχάομαι), [in LXX chiefly for תְּהִלָּה, תִּפְאָרָה ;] 1. a boast (Pind.): [[2-corinthians 5 12|2Co.5:12 9:3]] (Thayer, see word; e. contra, 2, Ellic., Lft., on [[galatians 6 4|Gal.6:4;]] Lft., Notes, 204, 277). 2. ground or matter of glorying: [[romans 4 2|Rom.4:2]], [[1-corinthians 5 6|1Co.5:6 9:15-16]], [[2-corinthians 1 14|2Co.1:14]], [[galatians 6 4|Gal.6:4]], [[philippians 1 26|Php.1:26 2:16]], [[hebrews 3 6|Heb.3:6]] (cf. καύχησις).† (AS)

καύχησις, -εως, ἡ (καυχάομαι), [in LXX for תִּפְאָרָה ([[1-chronicles 29 13|1Ch.29:13]], [[ezekiel 16 12|Eze.16:12]], al) ;] a boasting, glorying: [[romans 3 27|Rom.3:27]], [[2-corinthians 11 10|2Co.11:10 11:17]], [[james 4 16|Jas.4:16]]; before ὑπέρ, [[2-corinthians 7 4|2Co.7:4 8:24]]; ἐτί, with genitive, [[2-corinthians 7 14|2Co.7:14;]] ἔχω τὴν κ. ἐν Χρ. Ἰησ., [[romans 15 17|Rom.15:17;]] στέφανος καυχήσεως (Ez. l.with, al.), [[1-thessalonians 2 19|1Th.2:19;]] of the cause of glorying, a boast ( = καύχημα), [[2-corinthians 1 12|2Co.1:12.]]† (AS)
Κενχρεαί (Rec. Κεχγ-; ν. WH, App., 150), -ῶν, αἱ, Cenchreæ, a port of Corinth: [[acts 18 18|Act.18:18]], [[romans 16 1|Rom.16:1]].† (AS)

κέδρος, -ου, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for אֶרֶז, [[numbers 24 6|Num.24:6]], al.; χειμάρρους τῶν Κέδρων, [[2-kings 15 23|2Ki.15:23]], [[1-kings 15 13|3Ki.15:13]] (קִדְרוֹן) ;] a cedar: χείμαρρος τῶν Κ. (as in 2Sam, 1Ki, ll. with), [[john 18 1|Jhn.18:1]] (Rec. Tr., WH, R, mg.; τοῦ Κέδρου, T, WH, mg., see: Κεδρών, and cf. Westc., in l; WH, App., 89 f.; Abbott, JG, 513 ff).† Κεδρών (see: κέδρος), ὁ, indecl. (in FlJ, genitive -ῶνος; Heb. קִדְרוֹן), [in LXX: [[2-kings 15 23|2Ki.15:23]], [[2-kings 23 6|4Ki.23:6]], al. ;] Cedron (OT, Kidron): χείμαρρος τοῦ Κ., [[john 18 1|Jhn.18:1]] (L, Tr., mg., R, txt.; cf. Bl., 10, 5; Lft., Essays, 172 ff).† (AS)

κεῖμαι [in LXX: [[jeremiah 24 1|Jer.24:1]] (יָעַד hoph,), al. ;] used as passive of τίθημι (LS, see word), to be laid, to lie; (a) of persons: an infant, [[luke 2 12|Luk.2:12, 16]]; a dead body, [[matthew 28 6|Mat.28:6]], [[luke 23 53|Luk.23:53]], [[john 20 12|Jhn.20:12]]; (b) of things, to lie, be laid or set, stand: [[matthew 5 14|Mat.5:14]], [[john 2 6|Jhn.2:6 19:29 20:5-7 21:9]], [[revelation 4 2|Rev.4:2 21:16]]; trop., Θεμέλιος, [[1-corinthians 3 11|1Co.3:11;]] before prep. with accusative, πρός, [[matthew 3 10|Mat.3:10]], [[luke 3 9|Luk.3:9]]; εἰς, [[luke 12 19|Luk.12:19;]] ἐπί, trop., κάλυμμα, [[2-corinthians 3 15|2Co.3:15.]] Metaphorical, ὁ κόσμος ἐν τ. πονηριῷ κ., [[1-john 5 19|1Jn.5:19;]] to be laid down, appointed: of law, with dative of person(s), [[1-timothy 1 9|1Ti.1:9;]] before εἰς with accusative (of purpose), [[luke 2 34|Luk.2:34]], [[philippians 1 16|Php.1:16]], [[1-thessalonians 3 3|1Th.3:3]] (cf. ἀνά-, συν-ανά-, ἀντί-, ἀπό-, ἐπί-, κατά-, παρά-, περί-, πρό-κειμαι).† (AS)

κειρία, -ας, ἡ [in LXX: [[proverbs 7 16|Pro.7:16]] (מַרְבַד)* ;] a vernacular word, 1 1, a bed-cord (Aristoph., AV., 816; Pr, l.with). 2. In pl., swathings (cf. Field, Notes, 96 f.): [[john 11 44|Jhn.11:44.]]† (AS)

κείρω [in LXX chiefly for גָּזַז, [[isaiah 53 7|Isa.53:7]], al. ;] to cut short the hair, shear: a sheep, [[acts 8 32|Act.8:32]] (Isa, l.with). Mid., to have one's hair cut off, be shorn: absol., [[1-corinthians 11 6|1Co.11:6;]] τ-. κεφαλήν, [[acts 18 18|Act.18:18.]]† (AS)
κέλευσμα, -τος, τό (κελεύω), [in LXX: [[proverbs 30 27|Pro.30:27]] * ;] a call, summons, shout of command: [[1-thessalonians 4 16|1Th.4:16]] (see M, Th., in l).† (AS)

κελεύω [in LXX: I [[esther 9 53|Est.9:53]], Tob.8:18, al., and frequently in 1-4Mac ;] to urge on, bid by word of mouth, order, command (mostly of one in authority): with accusative and inf. aor., [[matthew 14 19|Mat.14:19, 28 18:25 27:64]], [[luke 18 40|Luk.18:40]], [[acts 4 15|Act.4:15 5:34 8:38 22:30 23:10 25:6, 17]]; with ellipse of accusative, [[matthew 8 18|Mat.8:18 14:9 27:58]], [[acts 12 19|Act.12:19 21:33]]; with accusative and inf. Pres., [[acts 21 34|Act.21:34 22:24 23:3, 35 25:21 27:43]]; with ellipse of accusative, [[acts 16 22|Act.16:22;]] ptcp. aor., [[acts 25 23|Act.25:23.]]† SYN.: see: ἐντέλλω (AS)
κενοδοξία, -ας, ἡ (κενόδοξος), [in LXX: Wis.14:14, 2Ma.2:15 2Mac 8:10 * ;] 1. foolish fancy, vain opinion, error (LXX, ll. with). 2. vain­glory, groundless conceit: [[philippians 2 3|Php.2:3.]]† (AS)
κενόδοξος, -ον (κενός, δόξα), vain-glorious: [[galatians 5 26|Gal.5:26.]]† (AS)

κενός, -ή, -όν [in LXX chiefly for רִיק and cognate forms ;] empty ([[genesis 37 24|Gen.37:24]], [[judges 7 16|Jdg.7:16]]). Metaphorical, (a) empty, vain: λόγοι, [[ephesians 5 6|Eph.5:6;]] ἀπάτη, [[colossians 2 8|Col.2:8;]] κήρυγμα, πίστις, [[1-corinthians 15 14|1Co.15:14;]] (b) vain, fruitless: ἡ χάρις, [[1-corinthians 15 10|1Co.15:10;]] κόπος, [[1-corinthians 15 50|1Co.15:50;]] ἡ εἴσοδος, [[1-thessalonians 2 1|1Th.2:1;]] κενά, [[acts 4 25|Act.4:25]] (LXX); εἰς κενόν, in vain, to no purpose (Diod., LXX; cl. διὰ κενῆς), [[2-corinthians 6 1|2Co.6:1]], [[galatians 2 2|Gal.2:2]], [[philippians 2 16|Php.2:16]], [[1-thessalonians 3 5|1Th.3:5]]; (with) of persons, empty-handed: [[mark 12 3|Mrk.12:3]], [[luke 1 53|Luk.1:53 20:10-11]]; vain, [[james 2 20|Jas.2:20.]]† SYN.: μάταιος, of the aim or effect of an action, κ. of its quality (Lft. on Cl. Rom., 1Co., § 7; Tr., Syn., xlix) (AS)
κενοφωνία, -ας, ἡ (κενός, φωνέω), [cf. κενολογέω (צָפַף), [[isaiah 8 19|Isa.8:19]] * ;] empty talk, babbling: pl., [[1-timothy 6 20|1Ti.6:20]], [[2-timothy 2 16|2Ti.2:16]].† (AS)

κενόω, -ῶ (κενός, which see), [in LXX: [[jeremiah 14 2|Jer.14:2 15:9]] (עָמָל pu.)* ;] to empty. Metaphorical, to empty, make empty, vain or of no effect: καύχημα, [[1-corinthians 9 15|1Co.9:15;]] ἑαυτόν, of Christ, [[philippians 2 7|Php.2:7]] (v Lft.; ICC, in 1, and esp. Gifford, Incarn., 54 ff.); pass., πίστις, [[romans 4 14|Rom.4:14;]] ὁ σταυρός, [[1-corinthians 1 17|1Co.1:17;]] καύχημα, [[2-corinthians 9 3|2Co.9:3]]† (AS)

κέντρον, -ου, τό (εκντέω, to prick), [in LXX: [[proverbs 26 3|Pro.26:3]] (מֶתֶג), [[hosea 13 14|Hos.13:14]] (קֹטֶב), [[hosea 5 12|Hos.5:12]], Sir.38:25, 4Ma.14:19 * ;] 1. a sting (4Mac, l.with): [[revelation 9 10|Rev.9:10.]] Metaphorical (as [[hosea 13 14|Hos.13:14]]): τ. θανάτου, [[1-corinthians 15 55|1Co.15:55]] (LXX), [[1-corinthians 15 56|1Co.15:56]], 2. a goad: pl., [[acts 26 14|Act.26:14.]]† (AS)
κεντυρίων, -ωνος, ὁ (Lat. centurio); a centurion: [[mark 15 39|Mrk.15:39, 44-45]] (Mt, Lk, use ἑκιτόνταρχος (-ης), q.v).† (AS)
κενῶς adv., [in LXX: [[isaiah 49 4|Isa.49:4]] (רִיק)* ;] in vain, to no purpose: [[james 4 5|Jas.4:5.]]† (AS)

κεραία (WH, κερέα, see App., 151), -ας, ἠ (κέρας), a little horn: of the point or extremity which distinguishes some Heb. letters from others (e.g. ד from ר; DCG, ii, 733), [[matthew 5 18|Mat.5:18]], [[luke 16 17|Luk.16:17]].† (AS)

κεραμεύς, -εως, ὁ (κεράννυμι), [in LXX for יָצַר, [[psalms 2 9|Psa.2:9]], [[jeremiah 18 2|Jer.18:2]], al. ;] a potter: [[romans 9 21|Rom.9:21;]] ὁ ἀγρὸς τοῦ κ., [[matthew 27 7|Mat.27:7]], (LXX).† (AS)

κεραμεύς, -εως, ὁ (κεράννυμι), [in LXX for יָצַר, [[psalms 2 9|Psa.2:9]], [[jeremiah 18 2|Jer.18:2]], al. ;] a potter: [[romans 9 21|Rom.9:21;]] ὁ ἀγρὸς τοῦ κ., [[matthew 27 7|Mat.27:7]], (LXX).† (AS)

κεραμικός, -ή, -όν (κέραμος), [in LXX: Dan LXX 2:41 (פֶּחָר)* ;] 1. (cl.) of a potter (e.g. γῆ). 2. In LXX and NT, = cl., κεραμεοῦς (Plut., κεράμειος, Polyb., -μαῖος, etc), earthen: [[revelation 2 27|Rev.2:27.]]† (AS)
κεράμιον, -ου, τό (κέραμος), [in LXX: [[jeremiah 35 5|Jer.35:5]] (גְּבִיעַ), etc. ;] an earthen vessel, a jar or jug: ὕδατος, [[mark 14 13|Mrk.14:13]], [[luke 22 10|Luk.22:10]].† (AS)
κεραμος, -ου, ὁ (κεράννυμι), [in LXX: [[2-samuel 17 28|2Ki.17:28]] (יָצַר כְּלִי)* ;] 1. potter's clay. 2. an earthen vessel. 3. a tile: [[luke 5 19|Luk.5:19.]]† (AS)

κεράννυμι [in LXX for מָסַךְ, [[isaiah 5 22|Isa.5:22]], al. ;] to mix, mingle, chiefly of the diluting of wine: [[revelation 18 6|Rev.18:6;]] by oxymoron, κεκεράσμενος ἄκρατος, [[revelation 14 10|Rev.14:10.]]† SYN.: μίγνυμι. κ. implies "a mixing of two things, so that they are blended and forma compound, as in wine and water, whereas μ. implies a mixing without such composition, as in two sorts of grain" (LS, see word κρᾶσις) (AS)

κέρας, -ατος (pl. not irreg. as in Attic), τό, [in LXX chiefly for קָרַן ;] a horn: [[revelation 5 6|Rev.5:6 12:3 13:1, 11 17:3, 7 17:12, 16]]; of the projections at the corners of the altar ([[exodus 29 12|Exo.29:12]], al.): [[revelation 9 13|Rev.9:13]]. Metaphorical, as symbol of strength, κ. σωτηρίας (cf. [[psalms 18 3|Psa.18:3]], al.): [[luke 1 69|Luk.1:69]].† (AS)
κεράτιον, -ου, τό (dimin. of κέρας), 1. a little horn (Arist.). 2. In pl. (the fruit of the κερατέα), carob-pods: [[luke 15 16|Luk.15:16.]]† (AS)

κερδαίνω [in Sm.: [[job 22 3|Job.22:3]] * ;] to gain: with accusative, [[matthew 25 16|Mat.25:16-17, 20 25:22]]; τ. κόσμον, [[matthew 16 26|Mat.16:26]], [[mark 8 36|Mrk.8:36]], [[luke 9 25|Luk.9:25]]; absol., to make profit, get gain: [[james 4 13|Jas.4:13.]] Metaphorical, with accusative of thing(s), to save oneself from, avoid: [[acts 27 21|Act.27:21]] (Field, Notes, 145); with accusative of person(s), to gain, win: [[matthew 18 15|Mat.18:15]], [[1-corinthians 9 19|1Co.9:19-22]], [[philippians 3 8|Php.3:8]]; pass., [[1-peter 3 1|1Pe.3:1.]]† (AS)
κέρδος, -εος (-ους), τό [in Aq.: [[ezekiel 27 24|Eze.27:24;]] Sm.: [[psalms 30 10|Psa.30:10]], al. ;] gain: [[philippians 1 21|Php.1:21 3:7]], [[titus 1 11|Tit.1:11]].† (AS)
κέρμα, -τος, τό (κείρω), 1. a slice, hence, 2. a small coin: pl., [[john 2 15|Jhn.2:15.]]† (AS)
κερματιατής, -οῦ, ὁ (κερματίζω, to cut small, coin into small money), a money changer: [[john 2 14|Jhn.2:14.]]† (AS)

κεφάλαιος, -α, -ον (κεφαλή), [in LXX (-αιον, τό) for רֹאשׁ, Num_4:2, al. ;] of the head; metaphorically, principal, chief; mostly as subst., κεφάλαιον, τό; 1. the chief point: [[hebrews 8 1|Heb.8:1.]] 2. the sum total, amount: [[acts 22 28|Act.22:28]] (other meaning, LS, see word).† (AS)

κεφαλιόω (Rec. -αιόω, [so in LXX: Sir.32:8 *]), -ῶ (κεφάλιον, dimin. of κεφαλή, in late writers) 1. (-αιόω) to sum up (Thuc., al.). 2. (In NT, only) to wound on the head: [[mark 12 4|Mrk.12:4.]]† (AS)

κεφαλή, -ῆς, ἡ [in LXX nearly always for רֹאשׁ ;] the head: [[matthew 5 35|Mat.5:35]], [[mark 6 24|Mrk.6:24]], [[revelation 1 14|Rev.1:14 9:7]], al. mult.; figuratively, ἄνθρακες ἐπὶ τὴν κ., [[romans 12 20|Rom.12:20]] (LXX); αἷμι, [[acts 18 6|Act.18:6;]] metaphorically, of a husband, with genitive, [[1-corinthians 1 13|1Co.1:13]], [[ephesians 5 23|Eph.5:23]]; of Christ, [[1-corinthians 11 3|1Co.11:3]], [[ephesians 4 15|Eph.4:15 5:23]], [[colossians 1 18|Col.1:18 2:10, 19]]; of things, κ. γωνίας, [[matthew 21 42|Mat.21:42]] (LXX) (AS)

κεφαλίς, -ίδος, ἡ (dimin. of κεφαλή), [in LXX for מְגִלָּה, וָו, etc. ;] 1. a little head. 2. an extremity, capital (of a column). 3. (As in [[exodus 2 9|Exo.2:9]], [[psalms 40 8|Psa.40:8]], [[esther 6 2|Est.6:2]]) a roll: κ. βιβλίου, [[hebrews 10 7|Heb.10:7]] (LXX).† (AS)
κῆνσος, -ου, ὁ (Lat. census), a poll-tax: [[matthew 17 25|Mat.17:25 22:17]], [[mark 12 14|Mrk.12:14]] (WH, mg., ἐπικεφάλαιον); τ. νόμισμα τοῦ κ., [[matthew 22 19|Mat.22:19]] (see MM, Exp., xv).† (AS)

κῆπος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX for גַּן, גַּנָּה, גִּנָּה, [[deuteronomy 11 10|Deu.11:10]], [[song-of-solomon 4 12|Sng.4:12]], al. ;] a garden: [[luke 13 19|Luk.13:19]], [[john 18 1|Jhn.18:1, 26 19:41]].† (AS)
κηπ-ουρός, -οῦ, ὁ (κῆπος + οὖρος, a watcher) a gardener: [[john 20 15|Jhn.20:15.]]† (AS)

κηρίον, -ου, τό (κηρός, wax), [in LXX for נֹפֶת, צוּף, [[psalms 19 10|Psa.19:10 118:12]], [[proverbs 16 24|Pro.16:24]], al. ;] honeycomb: κ. μελίσσιον, [[luke 24 42|Luk.24:42]] (Rec.; WH, txt., R, txt., omit).† (AS)

κήρυγμα, -τος, τό (κηρύσσω), [in LXX: [[2-chronicles 30 5|2Ch.30:5]] (קוֹל), [[jonah 3 2|Jon.3.2]] (קְרִיאָה), [[proverbs 9 3|Pro.9:3]], I [[esther 9 3|Est.9:3]] * ;] in cl., that which is cried by a herald, a proclamation. In NT (see Lft., Notes, 161), of God's heralds, proclamation, message, preaching (i.e. the substance as distinct from the act which would be expressed by † κήρυξις): [[matthew 12 41|Mat.12:41]], [[luke 11 32|Luk.11:32]], [[1-corinthians 1 21|1Co.1:21]], [[2-timothy 4 17|2Ti.4:17]], [[titus 1 3|Tit.1:3]]; with genitive cubic., τὸ κ. μου, [[1-corinthians 2 4|1Co.2:4;]] ἡμῶν, [[1-corinthians 15 14|1Co.15:14;]] with genitive obj., Ἰησοῦ Χρ., [[romans 16 25|Rom.16:25.]]† (AS)

κῆρυξ (κήρ-, T), -υκος, ὁ [in LXX: Dan LXX TH [[daniel 3 4|Dan.3:4]] (כָּרוֹז), [[genesis 41 43|Gen.41:43]], Sir.20:15, 4Ma.6:4 * ;] a herald: [[1-timothy 2 7|1Ti.2:7]], [[2-timothy 1 11|2Ti.1:11]], [[2-peter 2 5|2Pe.2:5]].† (AS)

κηρύσσω [in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;] to be a herald, to proclaim: [[mark 1 45|Mrk.1:45 7:36]], [[luke 4 18|Luk.4:18-19]]" (LXX) (but see Field, Notes, 174) [[luke 8 39|Luk.8:39]], [[romans 2 21|Rom.2:21]], [[1-corinthians 9 27|1Co.9:27]], [[galatians 5 11|Gal.5:11]], al.; in NT, chiefly of the proclamation of the Gospel, to proclaim, preach: τὸ εὐαγέλιον, [[matthew 4 23|Mat.4:23 9:35 24:14 26:13]], [[mark 1 14|Mrk.1:14 13:10 14:9 16:15]], [[galatians 2 2|Gal.2:2]], [[colossians 1 23|Col.1:23]], [[1-thessalonians 2 9|1Th.2:9]]; before εἰς, [[mark 1 39|Mrk.1:39 13:10]], [[luke 4 44|Luk.4:44]], [[1-thessalonians 2 9|1Th.2:9]]; ἵνα, [[mark 6 12|Mrk.6:12;]] with inf.. [[romans 2 21|Rom.2:21;]] κ. Χριστόν, Ἰησοῦν, [[acts 8 5|Act.8:5 9:20 19:13]], [[1-corinthians 1 23|1Co.1:23 15:12]], [[2-corinthians 1 19|2Co.1:19 11:4]], [[philippians 1 15|Php.1:15;]] [[1-timothy 3 16|1Ti.3:16]] (cf. προ-κηρύσσω) (AS)
κῆτος, -εος (-ους), τό [in LXX: [[jonah 2 1|Jon.2.1;]] [[jonah 2 10|Jon.2.10]] (דָּג) [[genesis 1 21|Gen.1:21]] (תַּנִּין), etc. ;] a huge fish, sea-monster: [[matthew 12 40|Mat.12:40]] (LXX).† (AS)
Κηφᾶς, -ᾶ (see Bl., § 10, 3), ὁ (Aram. כֵּיפָא), Cephas, i.e. Peter: [[john 1 43|Jhn.1:43]], [[1-corinthians 1 12|1Co.1:12 3:22 9:5 15:5]], [[galatians 1 18|Gal.1:18 2:9, 11 2:14]].† (AS)

κιβωτός, -οῦ, ἡ [in LXX: [[genesis 6 1|Gen.6:1-22 7:1-24 8:1-22 9:1-29]] (תֵּבָה), elsewhere, very freq., as [[exodus 25 9|Exo.25:9]] (10), for אָרוֹן ;] a wooden box or chest: of Noah's ark, [[matthew 24 38|Mat.24:38]], [[luke 17 27|Luk.17:27]], [[hebrews 11 7|Heb.11:7]], [[1-peter 3 20|1Pe.3:20]]; of the ark of the covenant, [[hebrews 9 4|Heb.9:4]], [[revelation 11 19|Rev.11:19]].† (AS)

κιβωτός, -οῦ, ἡ [in LXX: [[genesis 6 1|Gen.6:1-22 7:1-24 8:1-22 9:1-29]] (תֵּבָה), elsewhere, very freq., as [[exodus 25 9|Exo.25:9]] (10), for אָרוֹן ;] a wooden box or chest: of Noah's ark, [[matthew 24 38|Mat.24:38]], [[luke 17 27|Luk.17:27]], [[hebrews 11 7|Heb.11:7]], [[1-peter 3 20|1Pe.3:20]]; of the ark of the covenant, [[hebrews 9 4|Heb.9:4]], [[revelation 11 19|Rev.11:19]].† (AS)

κιθάρα, -ας, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for כִּנּוֹר, frequently in [[psalms 33 2|Psa.33:2]], al.); and in ([[daniel 3 5|Dan.3:5]], al.) for קִיתָרֹס, itself a transliteration of κίθαρις, the Homeric form of κ. (cf. CB, Dn., lviii) ;] a lyre, harp: [[1-corinthians 14 7|1Co.14:7]], [[revelation 5 8|Rev.5:8 14:2 15:2]].† (AS)
κιθαρίζω [in LXX: [[isaiah 23 16|Isa.23:16]] (נָגַן pi.)* ;] to play upon the lyre or harp: [[1-corinthians 14 7|1Co.14:7]], [[revelation 14 2|Rev.14:2]].† (AS)
κιθαρ-ωδός, -οῦ, ὁ (κιθάρα, ἀοιδός, a singer) one who plays and sings to the lyre, a harper: [[revelation 14 2|Rev.14:2 18:22]].† (AS)
Κιλικία, -ας, ἡ Cilicia, a province of Asia Minor: [[acts 6 9|Act.6:9 15:23, 41 21:39 22:3 23:34 27:5]], [[galatians 1 21|Gal.1:21]].† (AS)
κιννάμωμον(Rec. κινάμ-), -υο, τό (from the Phænician, see LS, see word, and cf. Heb. קִנָּמוֹן) cinnamon: [[revelation 18 13|Rev.18:13.]]† (AS)
κινδυνεύω (κίνδυνος), [in LXX for יָקֹשׁ ni., etc. ;] 1. to be daring, to venture. 2. to be in danger: [[luke 8 23|Luk.8:23]], [[acts 19 27|Act.19:27, 40]], [[1-corinthians 15 30|1Co.15:30]].† (AS)
κίνδυνος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX: [[psalms 116 3|Psa.116:3]] (מֵצַר), Sir.3:26, al. ;] danger, peril: [[romans 8 35|Rom.8:35;]] pl., [[2-corinthians 11 26|2Co.11:26.]]† (AS)

κινέω, -ῶ [in LXX for נוּעַ hi., רָמַשׂ, etc. ;] 1. to set in motion, move: [[matthew 23 4|Mat.23:4;]] τ. κεφαλήν ([[psalms 22 8|Psa.22:8]], al.), [[matthew 27 39|Mat.27:39]], [[mark 15 29|Mrk.15:29]]; pass. (cf. [[genesis 7 21|Gen.7:21]]), [[acts 17 28|Act.17:28]]. 2. to remove: [[revelation 2 5|Rev.2:5 6:14]]. 3. to excite, stir up: [[acts 24 5|Act.24:5;]] pass., [[acts 21 30|Act.21:30]] (cf. μετα-, συν-κινέω).† (AS)
κίνησις, -εως, ἡ (κινέω), [in LXX: [[job 16 6|Job.16:6]] (5), (נִיד), al. ;] a moving: [[john 5 3|Jhn.5:3.]]† (AS)
Κείς (Rec. Κίς), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. קִישׁ), Kish: [[acts 13 21|Act.13:21.]]† (AS)

κλάδος, -ου, ὁ (κλάω), [in LXX for דָּלִיָּה, כַּף, etc. ;] a young tender shoot broken off for grafting; then, a branch: [[matthew 13 32|Mat.13:32 21:8 24:32]], [[mark 4 32|Mrk.4:32 13:28]], [[luke 13 19|Luk.13:19]]; metaphorically, of descendants (cf. Sir.40:15), [[romans 11 16|Rom.11:16-19, 21]].† (AS)

κλαίω [in LXX chiefly for בָּכָה ;] of any loud expression of pain or sorrow, esp. for the dead, to weep, lament; (a) intrans.: [[mark 5 38|Mrk.5:38-39 14:72]] (M, Pr., 131) [[mark 16 10|Mrk.16:10]], [[luke 7 13|Luk.7:13, 32 7:38 8:52]], [[john 11 31|Jhn.11:31, 33 16:20 20:11, 13 20:15]] [[acts 9 39|Act.9:39 21:13]], [[1-corinthians 7 30|1Co.7:30]], [[philippians 3 18|Php.3:18]], [[james 4 9|Jas.4:9 5:1]], [[revelation 5 5|Rev.5:5 18:15, 19]]; πολύ, [[revelation 5 4|Rev.5:4;]] πολλά, [[acts 8 24|Act.8:24]] (WH, mg.); πικρῶς, [[matthew 26 75|Mat.26:75]], [[luke 22 62|Luk.22:62]]; opposite to γελάω, [[luke 6 21|Luk.6:21, 25]]; χαίρω, [[romans 12 15|Rom.12:15;]] before ἐπί, with accusative, [[luke 19 41|Luk.19:41 23:28]], [[revelation 18 9|Rev.18:9]]; (b) trans., with accusative of person(s), to weep or lament for, bewail: [[matthew 2 18|Mat.2:18.]]† SYN.: see: δακρύω (AS)
